name: Shokushu Makai no Ryoshuu ~Jashin Fukkatsu! Kutsujoku no Zenmetsu Kan'ochi End...
original_name: 触手魔界の虜囚～邪神復活!屈辱の全滅完堕ちエンド…
source:
An all-new tale in the Prisoner of the Tentacle Hell universe!
Starring ALL 5 characters from the series so far!
Persevering heroines are ruined to the core with immoral sin.
All endings are BAD ENDINGS. 

Marika and Emily, having failed to thwart Zodiac's resurrection of an ancient god, were now captured and continuously tormented by his lewd tentacles. Days of mounting obscenity drained the girls of all hope. Then a certain figure appeared before them... someone who had fought Zodiac before... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120934.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
触手地狱的囚徒宇宙中的全新故事！
迄今为止该系列的所有5个角色均由主演！
坚忍不拔的女主角因不道德的罪恶而彻底毁灭。
所有结局都是坏结局。

玛丽卡和艾米丽未能阻止佐迪亚克复活古神的复活，现在被他的淫荡触手捕获并持续折磨。日复一日的淫乱事件耗尽了女孩们的所有希望。然后，一道身影出现在了他们的面前……是曾经和十二宫交战过的人…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
